projects.title: Electro Monitoring System (EMS)
projects.stack: ESP32 • PZEM-004T • FIREBASE • WEB DASHBOARD • IEEE
projects.short_desc: Hardware-software IoT platform measuring electrical parameters in real-time with Firebase synchronization, interactive analytics, and IEEE-standard documentation.
projects.full_desc: A comprehensive IoT smart energy monitoring platform designed to measure voltage, current, active power, and cumulative energy consumption with high precision. Built using an ESP32 microcontroller interfaced with PZEM-004T electrical sensors, sending real-time telemetry to Firebase Realtime Database with Firebase Authentication. Developed a responsive web dashboard for end-users to inspect consumption trends and prevent overload incidents. Authored full IEEE-standard engineering specifications, UML use cases, class diagrams, and sequence flows.
bullets: Built hardware interface using ESP32 microcontroller and PZEM-004T sensors to capture voltage, current, and energy consumption in real time.
Architected cloud backend utilizing Firebase Realtime Database and Firebase Authentication for secure, sub-second telemetry sync.
Engineered an interactive web analytics dashboard providing live visual feedback and consumption trend forecasting.
Produced comprehensive project documentation following IEEE standards, including UML class, sequence, and component diagrams.
